mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_post (user_id, title, slug, summary, content, cover_image, status, is_top, allow_comment, view_count, published_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{slug}, #{summary}, #{content}, #{coverImage}, #{status}, #{isTop}, #{allowComment}, 0, #{publishedAt}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE t_post SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
